retainedReviewerFailures.cause: Reviewer compared Path-sorted and string-sorted inventory order; repaired by using string order on both sides. No producer or evidence change.
Reviewer log regex omitted the method suffix in Python unittest full IDs; all 49 resource phases had already passed. Corrected regex binds that suffix to the leading method name.

Reviewer assumed every successful method had same-line ok; two method logs contain interleaved runtime output. Final review distinguishes 198 observed method identities, 196 same-line ok records and aggregate actual exit 0/final OK.

reviewedCuratorHistory.explanation: The frozen independent report binds the earlier curator at its original path. Its exact bytes are retained at the mapped copy. The current curator adds review-receipt binding and this historical mapping; runtime evidence is unchanged.

independentReview.scope: Independent streamed artifact/source integrity and analytic zero-state/count/status checks; inspected primary curators reused for mechanical command and receipt binding. Saved admission outputs are bound, not recomputed.

limitations: Static synthetic payload only; no mechanical solve or new accuracy/path result.
Timing intervals include exactly the labelled process stages; post-controller includes snapshot acquisition/publications/restoration.
Linux RSS is process lifetime high-water; cgroup peak includes fresh whole-container charge.
Incomplete temporary files are not audited or promoted to final snapshots.
Original failed accuracy results and all source/construction/material/body/application gates remain open.
